# Project artwork

- Cal.diy-OIDC: existing `dashboard-icons/cal-com-light.svg`, the upstream Cal.com mark. See the dashboard-icons attribution and license files.
- Jev Ultrafast: `jev-ultrafast.svg` is the project's own wordmark/banner from https://github.com/antblu/jev-ultrafast/blob/main/docs/banner.svg (retrieved October 25, 2026). Original Browser Use / TypeSafe credit is preserved in the artwork.

The project carousel is an original plain JavaScript/CSS adaptation of the interaction described at https://reactbits.dev/components/circular-carousel. React Bits license is retained in `react-bits-LICENSE.md`.

Stack service cards use an original CSS/SVG interpretation of [React Bits Holo Card](https://reactbits.dev/c/components/holo-card), referencing its foil, glare, and tilt treatment. Source reference: DavidHDev/react-bits src/content/Components/HoloCard/. Local artwork: stack-foil.svg (original radial micro-etch pattern). Existing service logos retain their attribution. React Bits license is retained in react-bits-LICENSE.md. This adaptation uses layered CSS rather than the reference WebGL shader, with static touch and reduced-motion presentation.
